01 / ABOUT THE GROUPBUILT ON CONNECTION

Eight companies.One group.

Based in England and Wales, CADON GROUP PLC brings together eight wholly owned subsidiaries across Europe and Canada.

Our structure connects a healthcare-focused value chain with specialist capabilities in payments, secure logistics, property and branding.
